notes: Total incidence is extrapolated by dividing hospitalization rates by an external 3.2% hospitalization fraction (arithmetic). Bootstrap is stated only for those CIs; the CI method for hospitalization rates and the test behind p<0.05 are not stated. The 2020–2021 season is excluded from the average rate because it never reached the epidemic threshold.
view_issues: The Summary gives 86% admitted to obstetrics, against 85.5% elsewhere. It reports vaccination coverage <0.1% among women with influenza, but the only vaccinated patient tested negative. The abstract calls obstetrics (29.6%) and gynecology (23.1%) both 'the lowest'.
